name: Signature
pose: He stands with weight shifted onto one leg, shoulders relaxed, a sharp, watchful gaze toward the camera — a coiled stance ready to move, a faint, knowing smile, utterly at ease in the undergrowth.
effects: Loose leaves and faint pollen drift and swirl gently around him, stirred by the grove's living magic.

components.companion: his bonded Treant, an ancient tree-guardian with bark-like skin and leafy limbs, standing watch among the grove behind him

notes: First-pass minimal signature scene — reuses the rogue-group default wardrobe set + the existing ancient-grove background (fits Grass thematically).
